application.amountHelp: Choose the order item and refund quantity first, then enter the amount in minor units, for example 1299 for CNY 12.99. A specific entitlement is available only for ongoing services. The server rechecks every limit.
application.title: New refund request

approval.automatic: Automatic when all rules remain clear

balance.accept: Send unsupported portions to my balance
balance.acceptDetail: The total refund is {amount}. Portions that cannot return to their original source will go to your same-currency balance; all other portions stay original-source. Every portion starts together only after confirmation.
balance.declineDetail: If you keep waiting, none of the refund will execute and no portion will be returned early. You can still accept later.
balance.failed: The refund choice could not be saved. Refresh and try again.
balance.keepPending: Do not accept; keep all pending
balance.wholeHeld: One portion cannot return to its original source. The whole refund is paused and no portion has executed early.

history.lead: Track review, execution, and any balance-refund choice that needs you.
history.title: My refunds

lead: Choose the order item, refund quantity, and amount first. For ongoing services, also review the selected entitlement impact. Amounts, status, and destination are always rechecked.

messages.confirmRequired: Choose a reason and confirm that you understand the service impact
messages.orderFailed: A refund request cannot be prepared for this order right now. Return to Orders and choose it again.
messages.otherDetailRequired: Describe the reason when Other is selected
messages.previewFailed: The refund preview failed. Amounts, service state, or refundable limits may have changed.
messages.selectionRequired: Select at least one item and enter a positive refund amount
messages.submitFailed: The refund could not be submitted. Create a fresh preview and try again.

preview.confirmImpact: I understand and confirm the refund, ongoing-entitlement termination, and review impact shown above
preview.dangerousWarning: A selected service has an unfinished or unknown-result risky operation. The refund will wait for resource verification.
preview.entitlementImpact: Ongoing service “{productName}” will be handled as shown in this preview
preview.terminationWarning: This refund terminates the selected ongoing entitlement and may interrupt service or affect data. Protect important data first.
preview.title: Confirm refund amount and service impact

title: Refunds and service impact
